req.title: Reject non-string title
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field is not a string.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject non-string titles with an HTTP 422 response. This behavior needs to be validated through tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The positive case ensures that valid string titles are accepted, the negative case checks that non-string titles are rejected, and the boundary case examines the behavior with an empty string, which is technically a string but may be considered invalid depending on the implementation.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_string_title
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid string title.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Valid Task", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Task"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_non_string_title
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a non-string title (e.g., an integer).
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": 123, "description": "A task with non-string title", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_string_title
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty string as the title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "", "description": "A task with empty title", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 422
